faq.q: Is the result real or random?
faq.a: It's purely for entertainment with no scientific basis, but it is not random — it's deterministic. The score comes from a stable hash of the letters in the two names plus the mode, so the same names always give the same answer. The tool also sorts the name pair, so entering the names in either order gives the same result.

faq.q: What modes are there besides a love percentage?
faq.a: Four main modes: Love % (50–100%), FLAMES (the classic Friends/Lovers/Affection/Marriage/Enemies/Siblings counting game), Shared Letters (a breakdown of letters the two names have in common), and Friendship (a 40–100% meter). There's also a separate zodiac compatibility checker (a fixed 12×12 table) and a 10-question compatibility quiz for two people.

faq.q: Can I share or save the result?
faq.a: Yes. You can copy the result as text, use the native share sheet, or generate image cards sized for WhatsApp status (1080×1080) or Instagram story (1080×1920) with a gradient background. Your recent results (up to 20) are kept in your browser under loveHistory, which you can clear anytime — nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Does it work with Hindi/Devanagari names?
faq.a: Yes. The FLAMES mode specifically handles non-Latin scripts: it normalises and keeps letters and combining marks across scripts and compares by grapheme, so two names typed in Hindi no longer collapse to a default 'Lovers' result. The tool is explicitly a fun toy — it says nothing real about any relationship.
